description: Often heard before it is seen, this small, long-tailed songbird hides in dense coastal scrub. Listen for a series of notes that speeds up like a bouncing ball.
A warm brown bird with a cinnamon patch beneath its tail. Look for it hopping on the ground and scratching through leaf litter in gardens and scrub.
A bold bird with spotted wings and rusty sides, often foraging under shrubs. Its two-footed backward hop flicks leaves aside to uncover food.
Curious and vocal, this blue-and-gray jay is a familiar neighbor in oak woodlands and gardens. It caches acorns and other food to retrieve later.
A tiny, energetic hummingbird found around flowers and gardens. In the right light, an adult male’s head and throat flash a brilliant rosy pink.
